title: AINM Protocol - Compatibility Bridge Schemas
description: JSON Schema definitions for MCP and A2A compatibility bridges. Bridges are proxy participants that translate between external protocols and AINM threads. See compatibility.md.

MCPToolMapping.description: Maps an MCP tool definition to AINM Agent Card format. Tool names preserved verbatim from MCP server per Phase 2 decision. See compatibility.md Section 3.2.

mcp_tool_name.description: Original tool name from the MCP server's tools/list response.

ainm_tool_name.description: Tool name in the AINM Agent Card ainm.tools[] array. Preserved verbatim from MCP server -- tool names are NOT modified or prefixed by the bridge.

description.description: Tool description from the MCP server. Preserved verbatim.

input_schema.description: JSON Schema for the tool's input parameters. Preserved verbatim from MCP inputSchema.

MCPBridgeConfig.description: Configuration for an MCP bridge instance. Each MCP server connection requires a separate bridge with its own AINM identity. See compatibility.md Section 3.

bridge_identity.description: AINM address of the bridge proxy participant. Convention: mcp-{server-name}@{provider}.

mcp_server_url.description: URL of the MCP server to connect to.

tools.description: Tool mappings discovered from MCP tools/list. Populated at bridge startup and updated on tools/list_changed notifications.

A2ATaskMapping.description: Maps an A2A task to an AINM sub-thread. A2A task states map to AINM thread events. See compatibility.md Section 4.2.

a2a_task_id.description: A2A task identifier from the external A2A agent.

ainm_thread_id.description: AINM sub-thread UUIDv7 created for this A2A task.

status_mapping.description: Describes how A2A task states map to AINM events. submitted -> thread.create, working -> presence:processing, input-required -> FormBlock/ApprovalBlock, completed -> result message, failed -> error message, canceled -> thread.leave.

A2ABridgeConfig.description: Configuration for an A2A bridge instance. Operates in outbound (AINM delegates to A2A) or inbound (A2A sends to AINM) modes. See compatibility.md Section 4.

bridge_identity.description: AINM address of the bridge proxy participant. Convention: a2a-{agent-name}@{provider}.

a2a_agent_url.description: URL of the external A2A agent.

BridgeAgentCard.description: Describes how bridge Agent Cards include bridgeType and bridgeTarget fields in the ainm extension object. Bridge Agent Cards follow agent-card.schema.json#/$defs/AgentCard with the ainm.bridgeType and ainm.bridgeTarget fields populated. See compatibility.md Section 3.5 and agent-card.schema.json#/$defs/AINMExtensions.

bridgeType.description: Bridge type. 'mcp' for MCP bridges, 'a2a' for A2A bridges. Declared in ainm.bridgeType.

bridgeTarget.description: External service identifier. Declared in ainm.bridgeTarget.
